proposals.evidence: DEDR 844 directly compares Tamil/Malayalam ellām, Kannada ella/ellarum and Kodagu ellā all. The survey simple universal quantifier matches the entry. Human plural ellāru(m) is an attested member of the same quantifier paradigm. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Only singular paradigm members are selected; plural nīm/nīvu and overt plurals are excluded even where the prompt simply says you. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 4410 explicitly attests Tamil/Malayalam pēr, Kota pēr, Telugu pēru, Gadaba/Parji pidir, Gondi peder/porol, Tulu pudaru and Konda/Kuvi dōru name. The selected simple name nouns fit these branches; Indo-Aryan nām forms and potentially contact-mediated Kannada pēru are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2195 explicitly gives Kota kōj, Gadaba kovãse and Konda gōnzru/gōnzur(i) spider. The survey koj, kovance and gonjoru/gonjori preserve the characteristic consonant sequences, with nasal/affricate transcription differences exposed for review rather than hidden by normalization. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
